summary_reason: The content suffers from generic AI hallucination and severe domain inaccuracies: treating 利益準備金 (statutory retained earnings reserve under Japan's Companies Act) as a routine monthly operational expense account subject to '精算' and month-end ledger reconciliation, rather than a corporate-law mandated equity reserve tied to dividends.

collocations.text: 利益準備金を計上する
collocations.reason: Under Japanese corporate law and accounting practice, 利益準備金 is statutory retained earnings set aside upon dividend payout; the standard and legally accurate predicate is 積み立てる (to reserve/accumulate), not simply 計上する.
collocations.suggested_text: 利益準備金を積み立てる

collocations.text: 利益準備金の残高を確認する
collocations.reason: Natural and standard expression for checking the equity reserve balance on the balance sheet.
collocations.suggested_text: 利益準備金の残高を確認する

collocations.text: 利益準備金を照合する
collocations.reason: An equity item itself is not directly 'reconciled' (照合する); either its balance (残高) is reconciled, or in legal context, it is incorporated into capital (資本に組み入れる) or reduced (取り崩す).
collocations.suggested_text: 利益準備金を取り崩す

collocations.text: 利益準備金を精算する
collocations.reason: Fatal domain mismatch. 利益準備金 is a permanent equity item (株主資本), never an unsettled advance or expense account subject to '精算' (settlement/liquidation).
collocations.suggested_text: 利益準備金を資本金に組み入れる

examples.reason: 利益準備金 is not a monthly transactional account reviewed during routine month-end reconciliation. It is strictly accumulated when dividends of surplus are paid out under Article 445 of the Companies Act.
examples.suggested_ja: 会社法の規定に基づき、剰余金の配当に伴って配当額の10分の1を利益準備金として積み立てました。
examples.suggested_vi: Căn cứ theo quy định của Luật Doanh nghiệp, cùng với việc chi trả cổ tức từ thặng dư, chúng tôi đã trích lập 1/10 số tiền cổ tức vào quỹ dự trữ lợi nhuận pháp định.
examples.suggested_en: In accordance with the Companies Act, one-tenth of the dividend payout was set aside as legal retained earnings upon the distribution of surplus.

examples.reason: This is a vacuous AI template ('適正な...適正に処理いたしました') lacking practical business meaning. A professional example should illustrate the statutory cap (capital reserve + legal retained earnings reaching 1/4 of stated capital) or shareholder resolution.
examples.suggested_ja: 資本準備金と利益準備金の合計額が資本金の4分の1に達しているため、今回の配当では積み立てを行いません。
examples.suggested_vi: Vì tổng số vốn dự trữ và quỹ dự trữ lợi nhuận pháp định đã đạt 1/4 vốn điều lệ, nên đợt chi trả cổ tức lần này chúng tôi không thực hiện trích lập bổ sung.
examples.suggested_en: Since the total of additional paid-in capital and legal retained earnings has reached one-fourth of stated capital, no additional accumulation is required for this dividend.

dialogue.reason: Asking whether discrepancies occurred in 利益準備金 during monthly closing is factually unnatural; it is not verified against '証憑書類と補助元帳' in routine monthly bookkeeping. A realistic conversation involves dividend calculation and statutory reserve allocation.

suggested_turns.speaker: A
suggested_turns.ja: 株主総会で中間配当が決議されましたが、利益準備金の積立要否は確認できていますか。
suggested_turns.vi: Đại hội đồng cổ đông đã thông qua việc chi trả cổ tức giữa kỳ, anh/chị đã kiểm tra xem có cần trích lập quỹ dự trữ lợi nhuận pháp định hay chưa?
suggested_turns.en: Interim dividends were approved at the shareholders' meeting. Have you confirmed whether we are required to set aside legal retained earnings?

suggested_turns.speaker: B
suggested_turns.ja: はい。準備金合計額が資本金の4分の1に達していないため、所定の積立額を計算のうえ計上いたします。
suggested_turns.vi: Vâng. Do tổng mức dự trữ chưa đạt một phần tư vốn điều lệ, tôi sẽ tính toán và hạch toán số tiền cần trích lập theo quy định.
suggested_turns.en: Yes. Since the total reserves have not reached one-fourth of stated capital, I will calculate and book the prescribed reserve amount.

translations.reason: Both translations are accurate accounting designations for the term.
